title: FERAL DRUID

source.author: Ruse_Cruize
source.name: Mobalytics WoW Forever · Druid Leveling Guide (Level 1-30)

headline: Three phases: spells and Moonfire, Bear Form at 10, then sneaky Cat Form burst at 20, with heals to reset between pulls.

build.early: Before shapeshifts you rely on spells and auto-attacks: Moonfire from level 4 and Thorns from level 6. Bear Form arrives at 10 and Cat Form at 20.

why.Ferocity: Solid in every fight, in Bear and Cat Form.
why.Heart of the Wild: Extra mana for heals and shapeshifts, plus stats in both forms.
why.Feral Swiftness: 30% movement speed in Cat Form; dodge now works in every form.
why.Sharpened Claws: Crit chance for fewer points than before.
why.Predatory Strikes: A global damage boost to your shapeshifts.
why.Blood Frenzy: Synergy with Sharpened Claws and Elune's Light.
why.Leader of the Pack: Damage buff for you and your party.

core.t: Prowl up behind the target and open with it.
Keep it up if the enemy will live longer than 6 seconds.
Spam it to build combo points and deal damage.
Spend combo points; Rip if the target lives 10+ more seconds.
Heal yourself between pulls: Rejuvenation, Regrowth, Healing Touch.

items.t: with spare mana and at most 1 enemy in melee
heal first, then pull two enemies
to cut their damage (skip vs casters)
on groups; Maul on single targets
if the enemy will live 6+ seconds

notes: Cat and Bear Form now scale with weapon damage and use a new Feral Combat weapon skill: a high-DPS weapon matters.
Mana and energy regenerate continuously, so it is easier to spend down to 0 energy and less important to time casts.
Faerie Fire and Nature's Grasp are baseline; combo points transfer between targets; Druids can use polearms.
5 second rule: mana regeneration only starts after 5 seconds without spending mana, so batch your spells then shapeshift while it regenerates.
New abilities arrive on every even level: go back to the trainer every other level.

stats.t: Gives a little Attack Power in Cat Form, plus crit. Equal with Stamina.
Low value: healing is cheap and you do not use mana to kill.

gear: A high-DPS weapon is now extremely important because shapeshifted attacks scale with weapon damage.
dungeon_tips: Keep Mark of the Wild on the whole party and pets; Thorns on whoever is being hit.
Thorns generates threat for the target: with a tank it raises their threat.
You can flex between tank (Bear) and damage (Cat), and even heal early dungeons with relative ease.

alliance.note: Elune's Light is a 10% crit cooldown, best in long fights. Quickness now also gives 2% run speed.
Walk on Air, 1% haste and Read Ley Line, which is good for leveling but not in Feral combat.

horde.note: War Stomp, Endurance (+5% health and 1% hit), Plainsrunning and Cultivation make a strong profession-grinding race.
Walk on Air, 1% haste and a self-cast run speed buff.

races.pick: Tauren for the Horde, Night Elf for the Alliance.

trainers: Visit the Druid trainer every other level.
